hb-deps-approval.description: Human approval to add node-html-parser, xpath and @xmldom/xmldom as dependencies of @adhd/stealth-core-browser (absent from the scratch runner adhd/ package; new to the workspace dependency set)
hb-deps-approval.how_to_provide: Write docs/plan/stealth-browser/APPROVALS.md containing the line 'DEP-APPROVAL: granted' and naming the three packages

hb-release-decision.description: Dispatcher decision to publish (per PUBLISHING.md) or defer the release; names what agent-search consumes
hb-release-decision.how_to_provide: Write RELEASE-DECISION.md with DECISION: publish|defer, a CONSUME: line and the pre-push gate exit codes

hb-design-evaluations.description: The two architect evaluations are recorded (EVALUATIONS.md, EVAL-store-adapter.md, EVAL-service-proxy.md) and folded into the capture-upgrade and chrome-lifecycle criteria; the provisional defaults they rest on are listed as OPEN-DECISIONS in EVALUATIONS.md and are reversible.

hb-tripwire-domain.description: Human approval of the second package @adhd/resilience-core-tripwire and of the new `resilience` workspace group (decision D1), recorded with the verbatim request.
hb-tripwire-domain.how_to_provide: docs/plan/stealth-browser/APPROVAL-tripwire.md quotes the verbatim request, the approver, the date and D1-D4

hb-sp-release.description: Release of @adhd/sox-service-proxy 0.6.0 from the sox-ecosystem repository (a human go; publishing is never done by an executor). Done: the human approved the publish and @adhd/sox-service-proxy@0.6.0 is on the registry (`npm view @adhd/sox-service-proxy@0.6.0 version` prints 0.6.0, exit 0), together with @adhd/sox-embedding-provider 0.6.4 and @adhd/sox-mcp-runtime 0.3.6. sp-link already completed through the root pnpm.overrides dev tarball; sp-switch removes that override and re-locks against the registry.
hb-sp-release.how_to_provide: Done: @adhd/sox-service-proxy@0.6.0 published (npm view exits 0). sp-link completed through the dev-tarball override; sp-switch removes the override and re-locks against the registry.
